pr_body:
* Passes bundler options to workerfarm
* Persists these bundler options to every worker
* Moved all previous initRemote code to worker
* Improved workerfarm end function (to 100% sure kill all processes that are idle)
* Less concurrent workerfarm calls for faster execution (due to less freezing and overloading)
* Don't use the workerfarm on single-threaded machines
* Assign the custom worker functions to the process

Closes #1548 Closes #1286 Closes #1319

review_comments: What if we got rid of the specific `module` that a child has, and made the API the same for calling children from the main process and calling the main process from children. Instead of initializing children with a module, just pass the `location` of the module to call with each request, similar to how we do it for calling the main process.

The only reason I can currently think of is performance, as requires take up a lot of time.
The warmup workers will probably also become obsolete in this case.
Maybe - requires are cached though, so should only be a large perf hit the first time anyway. Worth testing it out.

I remember experimenting with it in #1235 Don't quite remember what the outcome was but I think it was slightly slower.

What about experimenting with this more in a follow-up?
